title: Name the viewer product
description: The namer process (brainstorm, collision sweep, domain signals) when the viewer approaches public release. The fort's name is the moot's; the product's name is this bead's.

title: Canonical issues.jsonl export enabled in every fort + fort-init template
description: Consequence of the Overseer's 2026-08-07 ruling: the passive .beads/issues.jsonl export is canonical for cross-fort bead state. Every fort maintains a fresh export; fort-init template ships it so new forts have it at birth. First task: determine the freshness mechanism (bd export is a command, not a daemon — find bd's auto-export config or hook; whatever mechanism is chosen must respect the hooks-masking rules, since .beads hooks dirs are a known host-RCE surface). Cross-fort application rides the fortkit-or2 backport machinery or the Overseer's hand — this bead produces the mechanism, the per-fort application plan, and the Manyhalls enablement.
acceptance_criteria: Manyhalls has a fresh tracked issues.jsonl; freshness mechanism documented and hooks-masking-safe; template updated; per-fort rollout plan recorded for or2/Overseer
